notes.title: Peku now supports controllers!
notes.content:
After this update, you will be able to play Peku with [b]any controller[/b] you wish to use. The controls are as always very simple and make the game even more fun.

To control Peku just move the joystick in the direction you want him to move. You also don't have to use the mouse anymore to start the game. Just press Start and it will load by itself.

Greetings for Zindeaxx Games and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Peku is now available!
notes.content: [b]Peku The Space Dragon[/b] is released and ready to be downloaded. Enjoy the game, while waiting for other games to load or while your pizza is being delivered.
